recipe_version.title: Southern Smothered Pork Chops in Onion Gravy with Rice and Green Beans
recipe_version.description: Bone-in pork chops seasoned and lightly floured, browned, then smothered and braised in a rich brown onion gravy until tender. Served over white rice with garlicky skillet green beans.

ingredients.name: bone-in pork chops
ingredients.display_name: bone-in pork chops, 3/4 to 1 inch thick

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.note: about 1/4 cup for dusting, 3 tbsp for the gravy

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 4 tbsp chops and gravy, 1 tbsp green beans

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, 1 1/2 tsp salt, and pepper and rub over the chops. Dust the chops lightly in flour, shaking off the excess. Slice the onions and garlic, trim the beans, rinse the rice, and chop the parsley.

steps.title: Brown the chops
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Brown the chops until golden, about 3 minutes per side, and transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Cook the onions
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium, add 2 tbsp oil and the onions, and cook, scraping up the browned bits, until soft and golden brown, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.body: Sprinkle 3 tbsp flour over the onions and stir 2 minutes until it smells toasty. Slowly whisk in 2 1/2 cups water and bring to a simmer, whisking until smooth and thickened.

steps.title: Smother and braise
steps.body: Return the chops and their juices to the gravy, spoon the onions over them, cover, and simmer over low until tender, about 30 minutes, turning once. The chops will be well above 145 F.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: When the chops go back in, combine the rice and 2 1/4 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; rest covered 10 minutes. This runs inside step 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Cook the green beans
steps.body: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium-high. Cook the green beans, tossing, until blistered and crisp-tender, about 6 minutes; add the garlic and 1/2 tsp salt for 1 minute.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon rice onto plates, set a chop on top, smother with onion gravy, and add the green beans. Scatter parsley.
